KLINTON ARKAS / MEET YOUR CANDIDATE

A LIFE OF SERVICE

From Dubois.
For Carnapol.

“I was born in Dubois. I was raised here, and I have lived in this city alongside you.”

First elected as Carnapol’s Member of Parliament in 2056, Klinton is seeking a fourth term. In his speeches, he describes eleven years of service and a determination to make Carnapol’s voice heard in Montiablo.

He has held four ministerial portfolios at once, including Energy, and now leads the New Progressive Party. His message is simple: people’s concerns come before political divisions.

KLINTON ARKAS · DUBOIS SPEECH

IN HIS WORDS

No substitute
for hearing it directly.

Read Klinton’s two campaign addresses
in full, exactly as supplied.

01
ADDRESS TO DUBOIS

“It is our great honor
to fight for you.”

+

I was born in Dubois. I was raised here, and I have lived in this city alongside you. In 2056, at the age of 27, I became Carnapol's Member of Parliament. I am now 38 years old. For 11 years, I have served you. With this election, I stand before you once again, seeking the opportunity to serve you for a fourth term.

Throughout these 11 years, I have worked tirelessly, without ever growing weary or giving up. Alongside my service in Parliament, I have taken on four ministerial portfolios at once. Critics have even dubbed me the "busiest minister." Yet even in the most challenging moments, I never took a single step back from serving you. In every piece of legislation in Parliament, I represented your will. I have stood for a vision of Carnapol that does not remain silent or unheard, but one that resonates in Montiablo, in the capital.

Today, following my dear father, President Draqi Arkas, entrusting his office to me, I address you as the leader of the New Progressive Party. In this election, I am once again asking for your vote. While parties on the left and right conduct politics through ideological divisions, we put people-centered politics above everything else. It is our great honor to fight for you. We ask you to honor us with another four years. Thank you, Dubois! You are wonderful!

02
ADDRESS TO CARNAPOL

“We have always said
that the future is ours.”

+

Hello, Carnapol! I am proud to be here with you today. As you know, we have an election ahead of us. I am standing before you once again to ask for your votes. I am here today for a fourth term, for an even better term. I am here to serve our country, our Carnapol, and every one of us once again.

At a time when political reactionaries have surrounded us and consider everything permissible in pursuit of their own personal interests, I have never surrendered to political self-interest as someone who cares about your problems. We have always said that the future is ours, and we have worked to become the architects of that future. With your votes, we will serve for another term.

Despite certain political groups trying to stand in the way of our technological progress, I have been one of the strongest supporters of artificial intelligence. During my time in government, one of the issues I placed the greatest importance on was artificial intelligence. Last year, as Minister of Energy, I supported the construction of a major artificial intelligence data center in Carnapol. I will not stop there. For your future and the future of humanity, I will continue directing vital support and resources toward artificial intelligence, space exploration, quantum technology, and new technological breakthroughs.

In this election, you will make a choice. You will either vote for someone who has served you for 11 years and has always cared about your well-being, that is, me, or you will vote for a few reactionaries, whether they are on the left or the right, who are trying to drag us back to the Middle Ages through political polarization. The choice is entirely yours, but remember: I trust you.

CARNAPOL · THE CHOICE IS YOURS

“I trust you.”

Another term of service.
A future we can build together.
